purpose: Find original Gen III hard limits that must be removed before later-generation content import

findings.problem: New logical species above the original bound are sanitized or treated as unknown.
findings.required_action: Replace original fixed species-end checks with expanded-profile registry/count checks while preserving classic behavior.
findings.implementation_status: ExpandedSpeciesV1 table implemented at 4096 capacity; runtime sanitizers/name lookups still need count-driven accessors.

findings.problem: Evolution fan-out is fixed to five entries per species and cannot represent arbitrary modern evolution graphs.
findings.required_action: Replace fixed [species][5] layout with count/index or variable-length evolution lists.

findings.current_bound: POKEMON_SLOTS_NUMBER = 412; save-owned/seen bitsets sized from it
findings.problem: Original save Pokédex bitsets cannot scale to later-generation species.
findings.required_action: Keep original bitsets for compatibility and add versioned expanded seen/caught bitsets after the save-sector audit.

findings.problem: UI/list/credits buffers are compiled for the Gen III National Dex size.
findings.required_action: Make expanded-profile Pokédex lists count-driven and audit temporary arrays before increasing counts.

findings.current_bound: Unown display species uses NUM_SPECIES + unownForm
findings.problem: Appending species directly after NUM_SPECIES can collide with the original Unown form encoding.
findings.required_action: Preserve an explicit compatibility mapping for existing Unown forms. Do not treat this as permission to implement modern form-change logic.
findings.implementation_status: IDs 412..439 are explicitly reserved from reuse until SPECIES_EGG and legacy Unown compatibility mapping is implemented.

findings.current_bound: Random/scan logic assumes a dense 1..NUM_SPECIES-1 namespace
findings.problem: Sparse/reserved logical IDs would be selected or scanned incorrectly.
findings.required_action: Use an enabled-species registry or valid-species iterator in the expanded profile.

findings.problem: Only a 9-bit candidate range is generated, so move IDs above 512 can never be selected.
findings.required_action: Replace mask-based selection with unbiased count/registry-based selection.

findings.problem: Expanded move IDs are sanitized or rejected by UI/battle text paths.
findings.required_action: Redirect checks to the expanded move registry/count.

findings.current_bound: NUM_MOVES is also used as an in-band sentinel
findings.problem: A growing table count is unsafe as a persistent sentinel and complicates relocation.
findings.required_action: Use an explicit invalid/sentinel logical ID (0xFFFF) in new expanded-profile lists.

findings.problem: Ability IDs above 255 cannot be represented in base species data; only two slots exist.
findings.required_action: Create an expanded ability table with u16 IDs and at least three logical slots; preserve classic BaseStats layout only for classic mode.
findings.implementation_status: ExpandedSpeciesV1 provides three u16 ability slots; legacy battle/runtime consumers remain u8 and are not redirected yet.

findings.problem: Even after widening species data, battle runtime truncates ability IDs above 255.
findings.required_action: Widen expanded-profile battle ability state and every controller/message serialization path that carries it.

findings.current_bound: abilities[4] and lastAbility are 8-bit-era protocol fields
findings.problem: Battle controller message structures must agree on widened ability IDs.
findings.required_action: Version or widen expanded-profile battle message payloads together; do not patch a single field in isolation.

findings.current_bound: altAbility is one bit and ability ID is derived
findings.problem: Modern three-slot/hidden-ability semantics cannot be persisted faithfully with one bit.
findings.required_action: Preserve the Gen III BoxPokemon core and persist expanded ability-slot state in the versioned save extension.

findings.problem: This path is already table-length-driven, but the relocated table and all pointer users must remain consistent.
findings.required_action: Retain count-driven behavior and redirect gItems references through the expanded relocation manifest.

findings.current_bound: Bag/PC slot counts are fixed separately from item ID width
findings.problem: More item IDs do not automatically require more bag slots, but UI/storage policy may later need expansion.
findings.required_action: Treat inventory slot capacity as a separate axis from item ID/table capacity.

findings.current_bound: type fields are u8; summary graphics use NUMBER_OF_MON_TYPES as an atlas offset
findings.problem: Logical type growth also changes UI sprite/palette indexing, not just battle type values.
findings.required_action: Keep a registry-driven type count and audit every graphics/summary offset before enabling additional types.
findings.implementation_status: ExpandedSpeciesV1 stores type1/type2 as u16; battle/UI type consumers remain legacy u8 and are not redirected yet.

findings.problem: The 2048-effect capacity policy cannot be implemented with the current 8-bit field.
findings.required_action: Use a widened expanded-profile move-effect ID and update effect-script dispatch/AI consumers.

immediate_p0_order: species runtime accessor/count boundary and gBaseStats consumer redirection
u16 ability battle/runtime state plus three-slot semantics
note: Debug-only bounds were observed but are not release blockers until production paths are clean.
completed_foundation: lossless conversion/round-trip validation of all 412 legacy gBaseStats records across 12 supplied ROMs
